intuition: A stack reverses order, so transferring entries between two stacks exposes the oldest queued item.

brute_force.approach: Keep a list and shift every remaining item when removing the front.
brute_force.time: push O(1), pop O(n), peek O(1), empty O(1)

optimal.approach: Push new elements to an input stack and lazily reverse it into an output stack when the output stack is empty.
optimal.time: push O(1), pop O(1) amortized, peek O(1) amortized, empty O(1)

edge_cases: Repeated pops and peeks reuse the output stack without moving items again.
An empty queue reports true from empty.
